Name: AirspeedKts
Notes: EXAMPLE ONLY - this file now MERGES onto the app's built-in, comprehensive field table (every scalar/RWR/light-bit signal from BMS's BMS4FlightData/FlightData2 structs - see Falcon4FieldMap in the source) instead of replacing it. You normally don't need this file at all: reference the native field names directly in your mapping profile (e.g. 'kias' for indicated airspeed, 'z' for ownship down-position, 'aauz' for the AAU altimeter reading, 'lightBits_MasterCaution' for the master caution lamp, ...). This entry just shows how to add a friendlier alias name for an existing field (here: 'kias' at byte offset 52) with tighter Min/Max clamps for a specific gauge - delete it, or add your own entries the same way, and set Enabled:false on any of the ~500 built-in fields you want to hide from the Live Telemetry list without disabling the whole default table.
